subject: Coordinating transition and payroll / severance steps for Neha Kapoor
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: planned last day (requesting guidance)

Hi Rachel / Dylan,

I wanted to let you both know that I have accepted a new opportunity and will be resigning from my role at Redwood. My proposed last day is Friday, 2025-08-01 (two weeks). I wanted to raise this directly so we can coordinate a clean handoff.

Questions I have for HR / payroll:
- What should I expect for final paycheck date and PTO payout?
- Is there a standard severance process or paperwork I should expect?
- Next steps for returning equipment and closing access?

I’m happy to help with a transition plan and will document current projects in the shared folder. Please let me know how you’d like to proceed.

Thanks — I appreciate everything from the team.

Best,
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Backend Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Brian Peters <brian.peters@brightpay.com>, Sarah Olson <sarah.olson@olsongrps.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: planned last day (requesting guidance)

Thanks for the heads up, Neha — and congrats on your next step.

Quick note to acknowledge receipt and start coordination. I’m looping People Ops (Laura) plus payroll (Brian) and legal (Sarah) so we can cover payroll timing, severance options (if applicable), and the asset return plan. I’ve attached an initial offboarding checklist for us to iterate on.

Action items I’m proposing now:
- Laura: can you confirm whether we will offer a severance package and, if so, send the term sheet for Neha to review?
- Dylan: please share a 1–2 page transition note and identify an owner for the top three in-flight tasks. Link your transfer notes in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XfT-transfer-plan
- Neha: please add a list of desk keys/assets and any service accounts that need deprovisioning.
- Brian: can you confirm final-paycheck timeline and whether PTO payout is processed through BrightPay?

Confidentiality request: please keep details between the listed recipients until we have an approved comms plan.

Rachel Kim
People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: offboarding_checklist_v1.docx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: planned last day (requesting guidance)

On Sun, Jul 20, 2025 at 9:05 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Neha — and congrats on your next step.

Neha — I’m sorry to see you go. I support the Aug 1 last day (gives two weeks). I’ll cover the following immediately:
- Create a transition doc with owners for the payment routing work and the OpenAPI migration (link above).
- Pairing sessions this week: Tue/Wed morning to transfer context.
- Confirm access that needs to be removed Friday after your final day.

I don’t have visibility on severance — Laura / Rachel can confirm. For comms, I propose manager-only until we finalize paperwork.

— Dylan

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Peters <brian.peters@brightpay.com>, Sarah Olson <sarah.olson@olsongrps.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: planned last day (requesting guidance)

Thanks all — Laura here (People Ops). Per our conversation with leadership, we are prepared to offer a short severance package to Neha to support transition. I’ve attached the initial term sheet for review. Key points:
- 4 weeks pay in lieu of notice (subject to exec approval),
- Continued medical benefits through 2025-08-31,
- Standard release agreement (DocuSign link to follow).

Brian — please confirm whether final pay (regular wages + PTO) will process on the next BrightPay run after Aug 1 and confirm timing to Neha.
Sarah — if you can review the term sheet for any required edits before we send to Neha, that would be great.

Neha — when you have a moment, please confirm that the proposed last day (2025-08-01) works for you and if you’d like to request a longer notice period; we can discuss but currently plan for Aug 1.

Attachment: Severance_TermSheet_NK_2025-07-21.pdf

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Peters <brian.peters@brightpay.com>, Sarah Olson <sarah.olson@olsongrps.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: planned last day (requesting guidance)

Thanks everyone — quick update and final next steps:

- Neha confirmed last day as 2025-08-01 via separate reply.
- Laura: please proceed with finalizing the severance term sheet and send the DocuSign link. I’ve included Sarah for legal review before sending to Neha.
- Brian: confirm payroll run and note: include PTO payout + final wages on next run; if there is any hold we need to know immediately.
- Dylan: schedule the two pairing sessions this week; Rachel/Laura will not attend but will be available if issues are raised.
- IT/Facilities: please schedule equipment pickup for Sat 2025-08-02 (DHL label attached).

Neha — thanks again for offering to document the transfer plan. We’ll keep comms manager-only until severance paperwork is signed. I will circulate a short internal notification once HR confirms DocuSign completion.

Best,
Rachel Kim
People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DHL_return_label_neha_2025-07-22.pdf
Link: https://app.docusign.com/seal/ABC-123-NEHA
